en: All righty. Wonder if there'll be anything here.
*rummage, rummage*
Nope, nothing relevant in here...
Oh, what's this? Father's diary?
Indeed it is. Invading his privacy would be uncouth, but, should I read a little of it?
Well, I want any kind of clue I can find, so Father, I'm sorry about this.
Although if I'm being honest it's exciting to find out what someone else writes in their private diary.
Hehe. Let's dive in! Lessee here...
April 5th:
Today I took my daughter on an outing.
How long has it been since I've seen her so pleased?
April 13th:
Today I played games with my daughter.
Watching her expressions ebb and flow like the tide made me feel happy for some reason.
April 21st:
These enjoyable days quietly pass one after the next. I hope life can continue to be like this....
Oh Father, you had me in your thoughts that much?
I feel tears coming on... *sniff*
Ahem.
Shall we continue reading?
August 19th:
Even after the exile, civil unrest in Russia has not been quelled.
We remain safe for the time being, but I wonder how long that can last...
October 23rd:
The flowing sands of time can't be stopped, nor can the rise and fall of the eras.
Something serious is bound to happen before long.
December 2nd:
A great many more people were killed today.
If this keeps up I fear that we will be in serious danger. I've got to think of some way....
Huh? It ends there?!
Oh phooey, just when it was getting to the good part.
Sheesh. Isn't there any more?
Nope, it looks like that's it for the desk.
If there were more pages, where would they be? Maybe in Father's own room.. Worth a shot, right?
But hold on, it said Father was Russian, no?
How can that be? I don't have any memories of life in Russia myself.
Did I just forget? Hmm, hmmm...
Not happening. I can't pull a single one.
Oh well. I'll have to worry about that later.
Now back to the task at hand. I need to find out more about Father.
I have been reborn, now as a regular everyday human being.
I am no longer a doll.  No longer a genomroid!
I will live on as a person,
surrounded by those I love....
